name: evidence-lane-plugin
description: Human-governed project memory that preserves exact evidence, resumes unfinished work, and keeps acceptance under the user's control.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence Lane 3.0.0 - 88 native actions (27 read / 61 write) - 17 governed skills.
interface.longDescription: Evidence Lane is human-governed project memory for Codex. It keeps source, worktree, project, Plan, ChatLineage, installed-runtime, candidate, and accepted truth distinct across long-running work. The package exposes seventeen governed skills and one package-local native MCP server with eighty-eight canonical actions: twenty-seven read-only and sixty-one write-capable. Queryable SQLite, FTS5/BM25 retrieval, graphs, pointers, receipts, Canon, AI Learning, and the cross-sector memory graph let Codex resume from bounded evidence instead of reloading raw histories. Source Intake, Build, Refresh, pointer-only Rollback, State Travel, Mode, storage and plugin administration, panels, search, diff, and governed Git evidence remain separate routes with explicit effects. Candidate acceptance stays human-controlled: natural intent never promotes a candidate, and only the exact governed approval contract may authorize Fuse on a genuinely write-capable host.
defaultPrompt: Boot Evidence Lane, verify ENV/UOP Flash, and show the six controls with host availability.
Show the accepted PV, Entry/Exit Slips, source lanes, and persistent plan without mutation.
Explain the current six-way HIL and exact next decision in clear business language.
